verdict.stance: Neutral / Abu Dhabi Sovereign-Equalized SWF Debt Vehicle (AA/Aa2)
verdict.summary: Mamoura Diversified Global Holding (MDGH) is Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala's primary debt-issuing vehicle, equalized at AA/Aa2/AA (Fitch support score 55/60). AUM reached AED 1,414bn (~$385bn) at YE25 alongside AED 143bn annual deployments; consolidated debt rose to AED 190.3bn (~$51.8bn) on portfolio M&A (CI Financial) while LTV remains ultra-conservative.

positives: Virtually certain Abu Dhabi sovereign backing (AA/Aa2/AA; Fitch support score 55/60).
Massive AED 1,414bn (~$385bn) diversified global AUM across AI/tech, energy, infrastructure, and private credit.
Deep GMTN & Sukuk market access across USD and EUR curves.
negatives: Consolidated borrowings rose to AED 190.3bn (liabilities AED 303.5bn vs AED 211.7bn YE24) from levered acquisitions (CI Financial).
Tight sovereign-proxy spreads limit upside vs Abu Dhabi sovereign bonds.
Rising private credit and illiquid alternative asset share in portfolio mix.

background.business_overview: Wholly-owned Abu Dhabi sovereign investor (Mubadala) operating via MDGH PJSC, MDGH GMTN, and MDGH Sukuk.
background.asset_perimeter: GlobalFoundries, Masdar, Nova Chemicals, Cepsa/Moeve, CI Financial, global private credit & PE.
background.ownership_governance: 100% Government of Abu Dhabi; PwC-audited IFRS consolidated accounts.
